summary: User can log in with valid credentials
description:
As a registered customer
I want to log in with my email and password
So that I can access my account and order history.

The login form lives at /login. After a successful login the user lands on /dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria:
Scenario: Successful login
  Given I am on the "login" page
  When I fill "login-email" with "demo@orca.dev"
  And I fill "login-password" with "orca123"
  And I click "login-submit"
  Then I should be on the "dashboard" page
  And "welcome-message" should show "Welcome back, Demo User"

Scenario: Invalid password shows an error
  Given I am on the "login" page
  When I fill "login-email" with "demo@orca.dev"
  And I fill "login-password" with "wrong-password"
  And I click "login-submit"
  Then I should see "Invalid email or password"

description:
As a shopper
I want to apply a discount code in my cart
So that I pay the promotional price.

Code SAVE10 gives 10% off the cart subtotal. Invalid codes must be rejected without changing the total.
acceptanceCriteria:
Scenario: Apply a valid discount code
  Given I am logged in
  And I am on the "cart" page
  When I fill "discount-code" with "SAVE10"
  And I click "apply-discount"
  Then "discount-message" should show "Discount SAVE10 applied"
  And "cart-total" should show "$90.00"

Scenario: Reject an invalid discount code
  Given I am logged in
  And I am on the "cart" page
  When I fill "discount-code" with "BOGUS"
  And I click "apply-discount"
  Then I should see "Invalid discount code"
  And "cart-total" should show "$100.00"

description:
As an API consumer
I want to list the product catalog
So that I can show products in the mobile app.

GET /api/products returns { items: Product[] }. GET /api/products/:id returns 404 with { error } when the product does not exist.
acceptanceCriteria:
Scenario: List products
  When I send a GET request to "/api/products"
  Then the response status should be 200
  And the response should contain 3 items
  And each item should have "id", "name", "price"

Scenario: Unknown product returns 404
  When I send a GET request to "/api/products/999"
  Then the response status should be 404
  And the response field "error" should be "Product not found"

description:
As a customer who forgot my password
I want to request a reset link
So that I can regain access to my account.

The confirmation message must not reveal whether the email exists.
acceptanceCriteria:
Scenario: Request a password reset link
  Given I am on the "reset-password" page
  When I fill "reset-email" with "demo@orca.dev"
  And I click "reset-submit"
  Then "reset-confirmation" should show "If an account exists, a reset link has been sent"
